name: YouTube Transcript (GetYouTubeTranscript)
description: Gets the full transcript of a YouTube video, in any caption language the video has, through the GetYouTubeTranscript API. Use it to summarize, quote or answer questions about a video. Optionally returns timestamps.
author: @tubeagentkit

input.hint: Your GetYouTubeTranscript API key from https://getyoutubetranscript.com/developers (new accounts get 100 credits)

examples.prompt: Quote what they say about pricing, with timestamps: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
Get the Spanish captions of dQw4w9WgXcQ

video.description: YouTube video URL (full or short) or the 11-character video ID

language.description: Optional caption language code such as en or es; leave empty for the video's default track

timestamps.description: Set to true to get one line per caption with its start time in seconds, for quoting
